text_block_list.text:
The summer training camp, which felt so long
yet went by so fast, comes to an end today.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Graaaasss!
Race you to the buuuus!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Alright, alright, I'll be right there~!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...I wonder what's up with her.
El has been getting awfully clingy lately.
choice_data_list: I wonder if she's all fired up for the race.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Though I wouldn't go so far as to shout
"Red-hot! White-hot! Passionate~!" like she does.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I don't intend to let anyone pass me, either.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: —Until I reach where I am meant to be.
